text: [shyly][happy] I made two. [flat, pleased] One's for you. [pause][chuckles softly] …Don't look at me like that.
[giggles][too long] Sweet egg… [smiling][bubbly] for my sweet boy.
[sudden flat][quiet] …I woke up at four [sweet] for this.
[happy][bubbly] Sweet. Like me. [perfectly even][smiling] Good input.
[sing-song] Sweet, ne? [proud][slow] I rolled it. Myself.
[sudden flat][quiet] Say that again. Slowly. So I can write it… [sweet] down.
[sudden flat][quiet] Salty. Noted. [perfectly even] …Forever.
[whispers][close] A minute. [whispers, slower] Then another. [whispers, slowest] Then the whole day.
[excited] Yay! Park first. [flat, pleased] I already planned it.
[sudden flat][quiet] …Fine. The rain can have you. [sweet] Later.
[breathless][tender] Hold my hand. [trembling] My hand is shaking. [whispers][close] Only yours… [whispers, slower] can stop it.
[relieved][happy] It stopped. [pause] See? [flat, pleased] It only needed you.
[sudden flat][quiet] Okay. My hand can wait. It is good at… [sweet] waiting.
[bright] One job before lunch. [sing-song] My groceries, or my library book?
[excited][bubbly] Groceries. [warm][slow] For our dinner.
[sudden flat][quiet] Alone? No. [perfectly even] Groceries. [sweet] Now.
[perfectly even] Do not look at her. [smiling][close] Look at me. [bubbly][rushed] I bought you a cup.
[tender] You touched this book once. [whispers][close] Right here. [flat, pleased] I kept it forty days.
[gasps][excited] With naan! [warm][slow] You know me.
[sudden flat][quiet] Then you watch me… [sweet] eat.
[sweet][close] Feed me. [whispers] With your hand. [perfectly even] Not the spoon. [whispers, slower] Your hand.

[playful][bubbly] I see you, the curly-haired guy. [giggles][too long] I see you, you gringo wearing a cap. [pouty][sing-song] Don't gang up on me, [smiling][close] you all NEVER stop my [perfectly even] eternal bond [flat, pleased] with my lover.
[warm] Twelve stops. Second time today. [quiet] You forgot. [perfectly even] I did not.
[slow] Three fingers. [whispers] Three times today. [perfectly even][smiling] Same train. Same you.
[bubbly] Share my umbrella. [sing-song] It is small. [whispers][close] Our arms have to touch.
[breathless][happy] Our arms touch. [warm][slow] Now I am warm.
[smiling] Your hand on the handle. [perfectly even] My hand on yours.
[sudden flat][quiet] Then get wet. Sick boys stay… [sweet] inside.
[tender][slow] Take small steps. [whispers][close] Small steps… [whispers, slower] make the day longer.
[whispers] Smaller. [whispers, slower] Smaller. [whispers, slowest] There. [giggles][too long] We are almost still.
[perfectly even][smiling] Same pace. Same day. Same you.
[sudden flat][quiet] Home? You are walking me… [sweet] home.
[warm][slow] I held it since noon. [flat, pleased] So I would be ready. [whispers][close] For you.
[smiling][slow] Every choice you made today led here. [pause][perfectly even] I planned them all.
[bubbly] I made tamagoyaki. [smiling] For no reason. [perfectly even][sweet] Eat.
[happy] See? [whispers][close][flat, pleased] You needed me.
